notes.title: Let the panic spread, a new update is coming!
notes.content:
This week the 1.0.1 version will be available to download. This update will bring these improvements:
[list][*][i]Added the option to invert the aiming Y axis for each player.
[*]The simplified aiming mode is now applied to the second player too.
[*]Rebalanced difficulty, changes in the collisions of playable characters and small enemy projectiles.[/i][/list]
Some of you have noticed that, at least, an old friend seems to have returned… that’s right, [b]Little Red Riding Hood will join the cast of playable characters![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36046499/3ff5b8769010696a2b8ba836a4ab97954493bf08.png[/img]

[b]But wait, it’s too soon to let her blow some zombies! [/b]
A new update will come soon with Red Hood as a selectable character in Arcade mode, but you will have to complete the Story mode first, so join the panic in advance and be ready for the time the red cyclone comes!
